title: 隆慶四年廣東武舉鄉試錄
隆慶四年廣東武舉鄉試錄
text:
新道役屬甌駱至萬餘里竊
僞號以自娛固一州之雄也
漢遣陸賈掉三寸舌以王命
讓佗佗惶恐頓首謝罪願世
世爲蕃臣其後越相呂嘉有
異志漢興十萬師討之令考
伏波樓船諸將軍中國人其
===
將戈船下瀨出零陵發夜郎
兵下牂牁江會番禺者則歸
義侯馳義侯皆越人也是時
降城賜印越既平矣獨呂嘉
與其徒屬夜亡入海越郎都
稽又從海上追獲嘉漢以爲
功侯之人言越人易反側至
punctuated: 新道役屬甌駱，至萬餘里，竊僞號以自娛，固一州之雄也。漢遣陸賈掉三寸舌，以王命讓佗，佗惶恐頓首謝罪，願世世爲蕃臣。其後，越相呂嘉有異志，漢興十萬師討之。令考伏波、樓船諸將軍，中國人；其將戈船、下瀨，出零陵，發夜郎兵，下牂牁江，會番禺者，則歸義侯、馳義侯，皆越人也。是時，降城賜印，越既平矣。獨呂嘉與其徒屬夜亡入海，越郎都稽又從海上追獲嘉，漢以爲功，侯之。人言越人易反側，至
translation_en:
… [The opening words 新道 are unclear.] He subjected Ouluo to his rule, extending his sway over more than ten thousand li, and usurped a spurious title for his own gratification. He was certainly a formidable ruler of one region. The Han sent Lu Jia to wield his persuasive tongue and, bearing the sovereign’s command, rebuke Tuo. Terrified, Tuo bowed his head to the ground and begged forgiveness, pledging that he and his descendants would forever remain vassal subjects.

Later, Lü Jia, the Chancellor of Yue, harbored rebellious intentions, and the Han raised an army of one hundred thousand to campaign against him. An examination [?] shows that the General Who Subdues the Waves, the General of the Towered Ships, and the other generals were men of the Central States. Those who commanded the Dagger-Boat and Downstream forces, set out from Lingling, mobilized troops from Yelang, descended the Zangke River, and rendezvoused at Panyu were the Marquis Who Returns to Righteousness and the Marquis Who Hastens toward Righteousness, both men of Yue.

At this time, cities surrendered and seals of office were bestowed; Yue had been pacified. Lü Jia alone, with his followers, fled by night out to sea. Du Ji, a Gentleman of Yue, pursued and captured Jia at sea. The Han recognized this as a meritorious deed and made him a marquis.
